strategy.name: Indices Trend-Following with Price Action Scalping

ema_20.purpose: short-term trend direction and dynamic support/resistance

ema_50.purpose: medium-term trend direction and key level

rsi.purpose: momentum filter — above 50 is bullish, below 50 is bearish

atr.purpose: stop-loss sizing and daily volatility measure

bullish: Price is trading above the 20 EMA
bearish: Price is trading below the 20 EMA
neutral: 20 EMA and 50 EMA are within 0.1% of each other (flat/choppy)
RSI is stuck between 45 and 55 with no clear direction

long: 20 EMA is above 50 EMA — trend is up
RSI is above 50 or has just crossed above 50
Price has pulled back to near the 20 EMA without closing below it
Price action confirmation: look for a bullish candle pattern at the 20 EMA (e.g. hammer, engulfing, strong close off lows) — do not enter on a weak or indecisive candle
For DEU40: check EUR/USD is not in a strong downtrend — DAX tends to struggle when euro is selling off hard
Enter on the next daily candle after the bullish price action confirmation

INTRADAY ENTRY (Break & Bounce method — ProRealAlgos): on the day of entry, box yesterday's daily high/low. On the 15-min chart, wait for price to break above yesterday's high. On the 5-min chart, wait for a Hammer, Inverted Hammer, or Bullish Engulfing candle to close after the breakout move. Only take this entry within the first 2.5 hours of market open. Never enter before the reversal candle closes.
short: 20 EMA is below 50 EMA — trend is down
RSI is below 50 or has just crossed below 50
Price has rallied back to near the 20 EMA without closing above it
Price action confirmation: look for a bearish candle pattern at the 20 EMA (e.g. shooting star, bearish engulfing, strong close off highs) — do not enter on a weak or indecisive candle
Enter on the next daily candle after the bearish price action confirmation

INTRADAY ENTRY (Break & Bounce method — ProRealAlgos): on the day of entry, box yesterday's daily high/low. On the 15-min chart, wait for price to break below yesterday's low. On the 5-min chart, wait for a Shooting Star, Inverted Hammer, or Bearish Engulfing candle to close after the breakout move. Only take this entry within the first 2.5 hours of market open. Never enter before the reversal candle closes.

exit_rules: Exit long when the 20 EMA crosses back below the 50 EMA
Exit long when RSI drops below 45 on a daily close
Exit short when the 20 EMA crosses back above the 50 EMA
Exit short when RSI rises above 55 on a daily close
Take partial profit (50% of position) at 2x ATR from entry price
risk_rules: Stop loss: 1.5x ATR below entry for longs, 1.5x ATR above entry for shorts
Position size: risk no more than 1% of account per trade
Daily loss limit: if down 2% on the day, stop trading for that session
Maximum 2 open positions across the watchlist at the same time
If price gaps more than 1.5x ATR at the open, do not chase — wait for a pullback to the 20 EMA
notes: Blends four sources: (1) standard EMA trend-following for daily bias, (2) prop-firm risk discipline from Emily / Mindfully Trading, (3) price action simplicity from The Scruffy Trader, (4) the Break & Bounce intraday entry method from ProRealAlgos (20+ years refined). Daily EMA/RSI setup gives trend direction; Break & Bounce gives precise intraday entry timing when conditions align. Review every 1-2 days on the Daily chart. DAX (DEU40) is most volatile around EU open (08:00 GMT); DJI and SPX peak around US open (14:30 GMT). For DEU40, EUR/USD currency strength is a useful context filter — a falling euro often drags the DAX. Break & Bounce entries only in first 2.5 hours of market open.
